less.sentenceEn: So as you can see, when it comes to choices, less is more.
less.translationZh: 所以你看，在做选择这件事上，少即是多。
less.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

less.sentenceEn: The decline of manufacturing and the increase in the number of people working in less labor-intensive occupations also has contributed to the trend, says Abraham, who researches work and retirement decisions of older Americans.
less.translationZh: 研究美国老年人工作与退休决策的专家亚伯拉罕指出，制造业的衰落以及从事体力劳动强度较低职业的人数增加，也共同推动了这一趋势。
less.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

less.sentenceEn: Research shows that when people choose from many options, they invest more in the decision, but feel less confident in their ability to decide well.
less.translationZh: 研究表明，当人们在众多选项中进行选择时，他们会在决策上投入更多，但对做出正确决策的能力反而感到信心不足。
less.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

less.sentenceEn: For those with a high school degree or less , the proportion of those working in their 70s had risen to around 10%, while those with some college education were in the middle at around 15%.
less.translationZh: 在高中及以下学历人群中，70多岁仍在工作的人比例已升至10%左右；而接受过部分大学教育的人群则处于中间水平，比例约为15%。
less.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

less.sentenceEn: What will Fayetteville witness in less than a month?
less.translationZh: 不到一个月后，费耶特维尔将会见证什么？

less.sentenceEn: More and more people have switched to less intellectually challenging jobs.
less.translationZh: 越来越多的人转而从事那些对智力挑战要求较低的工作。

likely.sentenceEn: But now, new research has found the cause and researchers may have come up with a solution for this frustrating traffic pattern: maintaining equal spacing between cars on the road, rather than driving so closely behind another vehicle that a collision(碰撞) is likely if that vehicle brakes suddenly.
likely.translationZh: 但现在，新的研究找到了这一现象的原因，研究人员也可能已针对这种令人沮丧的交通模式提出了解决方案：保持道路上车辆之间的均等间距，而非紧随前车行驶——当前车突然刹车时，这种近距离很可能导致碰撞。

likely.sentenceEn: Workers in more physical jobs, meanwhile, may be more likely to look forward to retiring, Baily says, suggesting those who stay on are more likely doing so for financial reasons.
likely.translationZh: 贝利表示，与此同时，从事体力劳动的人可能更渴望退休，这表明那些选择继续工作的人更多是出于经济原因。
likely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

likely.sentenceEn: They're also more likely to be in professional occupations where they tend to enjoy their work more.
likely.translationZh: 他们也更有可能从事专业性职业，并且往往在其中能获得更高的工作成就感。
likely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

likely.sentenceEn: The gaming industry is larger than films and music combined, yet few of us are likely to list our achievements in playing computer games as work experience in our résumé.
likely.translationZh: 游戏产业的规模已经超过了电影和音乐产业的总和，但我们很少有人会将玩电脑游戏的成就作为工作经验写进简历中。

likely.sentenceEn: When people have no way out in crises, they are more likely to embrace changes.
likely.translationZh: 当人们在危机中走投无路时，往往更倾向于拥抱变革。

likely.sentenceEn: The higher their educational level, the more likely they are to delay retirement.
likely.translationZh: 受教育程度越高，他们延迟退休的可能性就越大。

local.sentenceEn: W: Well, I think the local government could help improve things.
local.translationZh: 女：嗯，我认为当地政府可以帮助改善现状。
local.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

local.sentenceEn: Local newspapers reported that puzzled customers posted on Facebook groups to try to find out if the cat was lost.
local.translationZh: 当地报纸报道称，困惑的顾客们在Facebook群组上发帖，试图弄清楚这只猫是否走失了。
local.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

local.sentenceEn: Talking with local producers I learned that a small part of the production is sometimes wasted due to problems with size or shape, but the quality of the products remains unchanged.
local.translationZh: 与当地生产商交谈时，我了解到，有时一小部分产品会因大小或形状问题而被浪费，但产品质量保持不变。
local.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

local.sentenceEn: On a regular day at a local food market, people would find a display table with 24 different kinds of jams.
local.translationZh: 在当地食品市场平常的一天，人们会看到一个陈列着24种不同果酱的展台。
local.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

local.sentenceEn: Local business owners on Skillman Ave argued that their businesses would be ruined when parking spots were replaced by bike lanes.
local.translationZh: 斯基尔曼大道上的当地商家认为，如果停车位被自行车道取代，他们的生意将会遭到毁灭性的打击。

learning.sentenceEn: Catherine Ritman Smith, head of learning at the Design Museum, is expecting around 10,000 participants aged 13 to 16 to take part this year and says that the project—funded by Deutsche Bank as part of its youth engagement programme Born To Be—is the biggest event in the museum's calendar.
learning.translationZh: 设计博物馆学习部主管凯瑟琳·里特曼·史密斯预计，今年将有约1万名13至16岁的参与者参加。她表示，该项目由德意志银行资助，是其青年参与计划"天生不凡"(Born To Be)的一部分，也是博物馆日程表上规模最大的活动。

learning.sentenceEn: Flexible seating has been defined as movable furniture to create an engaging learning environment.
learning.translationZh: 灵活排座被定义为利用可移动家具来营造互动性强的学习环境。
learning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

learning.sentenceEn: When planning for this year, our principal asked what needed to change to engage students more in their learning .
learning.translationZh: 在规划今年的工作时，我们的校长询问需要做出哪些改变，才能让学生更积极地参与到学习中来。
learning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

learning.sentenceEn: It is a shift in practice from being teacher-focused to student-focused learning .
learning.translationZh: 这是一种从以教师为中心到以学生为中心学习模式的教学实践转变。
learning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

learning.sentenceEn: This began a journey to transform our practice and challenge the ways of learning for a group of Year 6 students used to sitting in desks and rows for years.
learning.translationZh: 由此开启了一段转型之旅，我们开始改变教学实践，并挑战一群六年级学生的学习方式，而这些学生多年来早已习惯了坐在成排的课桌前学习。
learning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

learning.sentenceEn: It is essential to human beings' language learning .
learning.translationZh: 这对人类的语言学习至关重要。

lack.sentenceEn: Many other designers and architects have expressed concern over the future supply of home-grown talent for UK firms, and industry bodies have pointed out that there has been a lack of roots-level support.
lack.translationZh: 许多其他设计师和建筑师对英国公司本土人才的未来供应表示担忧，行业机构也指出，在基层支持方面存在不足。

lack.sentenceEn: It concluded that pandas fail to wander off in search of new mates if they find their habitat too comfortable, resulting in a lack of vital genetic diversity.
lack.translationZh: 研究得出结论，若大熊猫觉得栖息地过于舒适，它们便不会离开去寻找新的配偶，从而导致关键遗传多样性的缺乏。
lack.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

lack.sentenceEn: Juices containing vegetables can provide more nutrients and less sugar than juices made up of just fruit—but they still lack valuable fibre.
lack.translationZh: 含蔬菜的果汁比纯水果制成的果汁能提供更多营养和更少糖分——但它们仍然缺乏宝贵的膳食纤维。

lack.sentenceEn: Volunteering can drop after the holiday season, and by February, some organizations lack the volunteers they had in surplus just a month ago.
lack.translationZh: 假期过后，志愿服务参与度会下降，到了二月，一些组织的志愿者人数已从一个月前的过剩状态变得短缺。
lack.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

lack.sentenceEn: Hiring managers believe unemployed workers over 45 lack good skills and are less adaptable.
lack.translationZh: 招聘经理认为，45岁以上的失业人员缺乏良好的技能，且适应能力较差。

lack.sentenceEn: They will find themselves lacking in all the skills they need.
lack.translationZh: 他们会发现自己缺乏所需的全部技能。

least.sentenceEn: There are now at least five different cats who come almost on a daily basis.
least.translationZh: 现在每天几乎至少有五只不同的猫会来。
least.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

least.sentenceEn: The art of telling a story using music has not faded in the least bit.
least.translationZh: 用音乐讲述故事的艺术丝毫没有褪色。
least.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

least.sentenceEn: And the researchers in the new study have calculated that solving phantom jams could save at least some of the estimated $121 billion per year that traffic jams are estimated to cost the U.S. economy, Horn told Live Science.
least.translationZh: 霍恩告诉《生活科学》杂志，这项新研究的研究人员计算出，解决幽灵堵车问题至少可以节省美国经济每年因交通拥堵造成的约1210亿美元损失中的一部分。

least.sentenceEn: She said business fell by at least 40 percent when the city removed nearby parking to put in a bike lane.
least.translationZh: 她表示，由于城市为了修建自行车道而拆除了附近的停车位，生意额至少下降了40%。

least.sentenceEn: But "the research hasn't really changed minds, at least not yet," says one of the authors of the study, Dr Matthew Barr.
least.translationZh: 但该项研究的作者之一马修·巴尔博士表示，“这些研究并没有真正改变人们的看法，至少目前还没有。”

least.sentenceEn: People from poor neighborhoods tend to have the least interest in retraining.
least.translationZh: 贫困地区的居民往往对重新接受培训最不感兴趣。

later.sentenceEn: Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection, the four-year-old cat was later reunited with its owner, Mr King's neighbour.
later.translationZh: 在获得英国慈善机构“猫咪保护协会”的救助后，这只四岁的猫随后与主人——即金先生的邻居团聚了。
later.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

later.sentenceEn: A day later the students were offered a choice of snacks and drinks in a seemingly unrelated context.
later.translationZh: 一天后，学生们在看似无关的情况下获得了选择零食和饮料的机会。
later.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

later.sentenceEn: For every three nature-related words in hit songs of the 1950s, researchers found, there was only slightly more than one 50 years later .
later.translationZh: 研究人员发现，20世纪50年代热门歌曲中每出现三个与自然相关的词汇，50年后的热门歌曲中仅出现略多于一个。
later.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

later.sentenceEn: 15 minutes and a few clicks later , with more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart, Kate placed the order and ran off to play.
later.translationZh: 十五分钟后，几番点击操作，凯特的购物车里已经装了价值超过350美元的娃娃。她下了订单，然后跑去玩了。
later.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

later.sentenceEn: These results remained when researchers followed up six weeks later .
later.translationZh: 研究人员在六周后的随访中发现，这些改善效果仍然存在。
later.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

later.sentenceEn: Those who have more job satisfaction tend to retire later than those who have less.
later.translationZh: 工作满意度较高的人往往比工作满意度较低的人更晚退休。

link.sentenceEn: Studies have also linked employee volunteer programs with more productive employees.
link.translationZh: 研究还发现，员工志愿者项目与更高效的员工之间存在关联。
link.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

link.sentenceEn: Aside from the link to type 2 diabetes, many studies agree that fruit juice is harmful if it contributes to an excess in calories.
link.translationZh: 除了与2型糖尿病有关联外，许多研究一致认为，如果果汁导致热量摄入过剩，那么它是有害的。

link.sentenceEn: Fruit juice also has been linked to claims that it can help you both lose weight and stay healthy.
link.translationZh: 果汁也一直被宣称有助于减肥和保持健康。

link.sentenceEn: In 2013, researchers analysed the health data of 100,000 people collected between 1986 and 2009 and found that fruit juice consumption was linked with increased risk of type 2 diabetes.
link.translationZh: 2013年，研究人员分析了1986年至2009年间收集的10万人健康数据，发现饮用果汁与2型糖尿病风险增加有关联。

link.sentenceEn: Diets high in fibre have been linked to a lower risk of developing heart disease, stroke, high blood pressure and diabetes, and it's recommended adults consume 30g per day.
link.translationZh: 高纤维饮食与降低患心脏病、中风、高血压和糖尿病的风险有关，建议成年人每天摄入30克纤维。

link.sentenceEn: It frees people from any known link to cancer.
link.translationZh: 它使人们摆脱了与癌症的任何已知关联。

loss.sentenceEn: But if they don't, it is their loss , not ours.
loss.translationZh: 但如果他们不这样做，那是他们的损失，不是我们的。
loss.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

loss.sentenceEn: This indicates that the brain is able to compensate for loss of certain brain structure.
loss.translationZh: 这表明大脑能够补偿某些脑结构的损失。
loss.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

loss.sentenceEn: What's more, that section of road saw new businesses open, while Queens overall had a net loss .
loss.translationZh: 更重要的是，那段路段有新商家开业，而皇后区整体却呈现净亏损。

loss.sentenceEn: So while Hughes supports bike lanes — "cyclists deserve to be safe" — she sees the parking loss as an existential risk.
loss.translationZh: 因此，尽管休斯支持增设自行车道——“骑行者理应享有安全保障”——但她认为停车位的减少是一种生存威胁。

loss.sentenceEn: What does the passage say is a negative side effect of water loss ?
loss.translationZh: 这篇文章说水分流失的一个负面副作用是什么？

loss.sentenceEn: Compensate for the Swiss manufacturer's loss .
loss.translationZh: 补偿该瑞士制造商的损失。

limit.sentenceEn: So while fruit juice is better than no fruit at all, there are limits .
limit.translationZh: 因此，虽然果汁总比完全不吃水果要好，但也有其局限性。

limit.sentenceEn: You'll be pushed to your limits , and if you aren't focused you'll make dangerous mistakes.
limit.translationZh: 你将被推向极限，如果不够专注，就会犯下危险的错误。
limit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

limit.sentenceEn: But we already have many of the technologies needed to start limiting its impact on our planet.
limit.translationZh: 但我们已经拥有许多开始限制其对地球影响所需的技术。
limit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

limit.sentenceEn: People living in rural areas, however, lag behind in online use, which limits their access to government services, banking and job opportunities.
limit.translationZh: 然而，农村地区居民在互联网使用方面却落后了，这限制了他们获取政府服务、银行服务和就业机会的途径。
limit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

limit.sentenceEn: According to a researcher, bad reputation about games will probably limit a gamer's chances of landing a job.
limit.translationZh: 据一位研究人员称，关于游戏的负面名声可能会降低游戏玩家获得工作的机会。

limit.sentenceEn: Nursing homes should be strictly limited in size.
limit.translationZh: 养老院的规模应当受到严格限制。

launch.sentenceEn: So I'm launching a campaign to stop people complaining about being "busy."
launch.translationZh: 所以我发起了一项活动，旨在阻止人们抱怨自己'太忙了'。
launch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

launch.sentenceEn: Whatever your long-term goals may be—getting in better shape, launching your own business, writing a book—thinking about your deadline in terms of days rather than months or years can help you wrap your mind around how close the future really is.
launch.translationZh: 无论你的长期目标是什么——比如健身塑形、创业、写书——将截止日期按天计算而非按月或按年，能帮助你更真切地感受到未来其实近在咫尺。

launch.sentenceEn: One water bottle company launched recycled half-litre "eco" bottles alongside its standard bottles.
launch.translationZh: 一家水瓶公司在其标准瓶旁边推出了半升装的再生材料"环保"瓶。

launch.sentenceEn: It also launched a range of fancy bottles that work with tap water and flavour packets.
launch.translationZh: 该公司还推出了一系列精美的瓶子，可搭配自来水和调味包使用。

launch.sentenceEn: There were 114 space launches in 2020, but there may be up to 1,000 per year in future.
launch.translationZh: 2020年全球共进行了114次航天发射，但未来每年的发射次数可能高达1000次。
launch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

launch.sentenceEn: Why is the speaker launching a campaign?
launch.translationZh: 演讲者为何发起这项运动？

labor.sentenceEn: He suggests that many college-educated workers are choosing to stay in the labor force more for social benefits than for financial reasons.
labor.translationZh: 他认为，许多受过大学教育的职场人士之所以选择继续留在劳动力市场，更多是为了获得社交益处，而非出于经济因素的考量。
labor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

labor.sentenceEn: Americans now have a labor market in which millions of people—those with fewer skills and less education—are seeking whatever poorly paid work they can get.
labor.translationZh: 如今，美国的劳动力市场呈现这样一种状况：数百万技能水平较低、教育程度不高的人正在寻找任何能够得到的低收入工作。

labor.sentenceEn: This is the idea that less labor will be necessary because machines can do so much.
labor.translationZh: 这种观点认为，由于机器可以完成如此多的工作，所需的劳动力将会减少。

labor.sentenceEn: Friedman believes that for many top earners, work is a labor of love.
labor.translationZh: 弗里德曼认为，对于许多高收入者而言，工作是出于热爱的付出。

labor.sentenceEn: In the U.S. labor market, the primary concern of people with less schooling and fewer skills is to secure any employment even if it is low-paid.
labor.translationZh: 在美国劳动力市场中，受教育程度较低、技能较少的人群最关心的是找到任何工作，即使是低薪工作。

labor.sentenceEn: More men than women are likely to stay in the labor force until their late seventies.
labor.translationZh: 相比女性，男性更有可能在接近八十岁时仍活跃在劳动力市场中。

lane.sentenceEn: Given that sort of mess, can political fights over bike lanes ever end?
lane.translationZh: 鉴于这种乱象，关于自行车道的政治纷争会有平息的一天吗？

lane.sentenceEn: "For our business, the bike lanes are way worse than Covid was."
lane.translationZh: 对于我们的生意来说，自行车道的负面影响远比新冠疫情还要糟糕。

lane.sentenceEn: Five years ago, the city of Queens, New York, announced that it would be putting bike lanes onto a stretch of Skillman Ave — and removing 116 parking spots.
lane.translationZh: 五年前，纽约市皇后区宣布，将在斯基尔曼大道的部分路段增设自行车道，并为此取消 116 个停车位。

lane.sentenceEn: Beyond New York, a survey of research from 23 cities found that bike lanes and pedestrian-friendly design didn't hurt local retail and food stores.
lane.translationZh: 除纽约外，一项针对 23 个城市的研究调查发现，自行车道和行人友好的设计并未对当地零售店和餐饮店产生负面影响。

lane.sentenceEn: In the year after the bike lanes arrived, businesses on Skillman saw sales rise by 12 percent, compared to 3 percent for Queens in general.
lane.translationZh: 在自行车道建成后的一年里，斯基尔曼大道沿线商铺的销售额增长了12%，而同期皇后区的整体增长率仅为3%。

lane.sentenceEn: Local business owners on Skillman Ave argued that their businesses would be ruined when parking spots were replaced by bike lanes .
lane.translationZh: 斯基尔曼大道上的当地商家认为，如果停车位被自行车道取代，他们的生意将会遭到毁灭性的打击。

lifestyle.sentenceEn: Customers loved the outdoor seating so much that cities are making it permanent: A New York City study of several streets closed during Covid found storeowners making more than before, and diners enjoying the outdoor lifestyle .
lifestyle.translationZh: 由于顾客对室外座位的喜爱，多座城市正将其设为永久设施：一项针对纽约市疫情期间封锁街道的研究发现，店主的收入超过了以往，食客们也非常享受这种户外生活方式。

lifestyle.sentenceEn: Is it his religion, health condition, or lifestyle ?
lifestyle.translationZh: 是因为他的宗教信仰、健康状况，还是生活方式？
lifestyle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

lifestyle.sentenceEn: The large majority of our traits and diseases also depend upon non-genetic factors, such as lifestyle , the environment, and many others.
lifestyle.translationZh: 我们绝大多数的特征和疾病还取决于非遗传因素，例如生活方式、环境以及许多其他因素。

The internet is too easy and too unreliable a research tool, so let's leave phones and laptops at home, and show them a different world in their lessons—one of books and pens," he says.
laptop.translationZh: 他说：“学生在这两种环境中应该有不同的行为方式。孩子们在日常生活中已经有了足够多的屏幕时间，没必要再把手机带到教室里来。互联网作为研究工具虽然便捷但太不可靠，所以我们应该让手机和笔记本电脑留在家里，在课堂上为他们展示一个不同的世界——一个有书本和笔的世界。”
laptop.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

laptop.sentenceEn: Online classes also require either a computer or laptop and a reliable internet connection.

laptop.sentenceEn: For the presentation, I'll bring my own laptop and hook it up to their projector.

laptop.sentenceEn: Buying a laptop proved a necessity and, thankfully, a relative bought me one as a gift.

literacy.sentenceEn: There are undoubtedly hundreds of great resources out there for those wishing to improve their financial literacy , but while I was researching, I still kept wishing that I didn't have to play catch-up with the money world.
literacy.translationZh: 对于那些希望提高自身金融素养的人来说，市面上无疑有数百种优质资源可供选择，但在我研究的过程中，我仍然一直希望自己不必在金钱世界里追赶别人的脚步。
literacy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

literacy.sentenceEn: It shouldn't be just a one-day event but a course integrated throughout the whole of high school that would allow students to gradually expand their financial literacy , and would prevent the need for a 'catch up' phase once we're out on our own after graduation.
literacy.translationZh: 这不应只是一个单日活动，而应是一门贯穿整个高中阶段的课程，让学生能够逐步提升金融素养，并避免我们毕业后独立生活时还需要一个'追赶'阶段。
literacy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

literacy.sentenceEn: With a literacy rate in some parts of Africa at only 22.6%, farmers are often "underpaid for their produce because they might be unaware of the prevailing prices," says Francis Dittoh, a researcher behind Mr Meteo, a speech-based weather information service.
literacy.translationZh: 非洲部分地区的识字率仅为22.6%，农民们常常“因不了解当前市场价格而使农产品被压价”，弗朗西斯·迪托说道。他是基于语音的天气信息服务“气象先生”(Mr Meteo)背后的研究人员。

literacy.sentenceEn: But surely all this short-form writing is affecting literacy ?
literacy.translationZh: 但可以肯定的是，所有这些简短形式的写作正在影响读写能力吗？

literature.sentenceEn: A bank is more likely to hire a literature graduate who spent their summers working in their local bank than a finance or economics graduate who spent their summers surfing or traveling around Italy.

literature.sentenceEn: Shakespeare probably attended the grammar school in Stratford, where he would have studied Latin and read classical literature .
literature.translationZh: 莎士比亚很可能就读于斯特拉福德的文法学校，在那里他学习了拉丁语并阅读了古典文学。

logical.sentenceEn: The logical question to ask is, "What happens even earlier?"
logical.translationZh: 合乎逻辑的问题是：“更早之前发生了什么？”

logical.sentenceEn: Using visual aids to back up your ideas can help communicate your ideas better and make compelling arguments so your listeners will come to a logical choice and become fully committed to your ideas and plans.

logical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

logical.sentenceEn: When you realize this and begin to direct your focus toward practicing better habits day-in and day-out, continual progress will be the logical outcome.

logical.sentenceEn: While tradition is one thing, there isn't any logical reason to completely change your name.
logical.translationZh: 传统归传统，但完全更改姓氏并没有什么合乎逻辑的理由。

landscape.sentenceEn: For instance, the Inuit people of the Arctic regions have created incredible modes to deal with the challenges of living in northern climates, but what we forget about are the tens of thousands of people that tried and failed to make it in those challenging landscapes .

landscape.sentenceEn: If that weren't already implied by the landscape —rolling green hills, palm trees, sun-kissed flowers—then it's evident in the many stories of people who grew up poor in these sleepy neighborhoods and rose to enormous success.
